A useful reminder about crate labels
It is for everyone using the desk
Crate labels need a quick check before travel.

Please make sure every label is easy to read and firmly attached to the crate before you arrive at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. Clear labels help our team match each animal with the right booking details and keep the handover smooth for everyone involved. If a label looks loose, faded, or hard to read, we will ask for a fresh one so the journey can begin without delay.

Our handlers use calm and humane methods around animals at every step. Passengers are given clear guidance before departure, and the welcome team is ready to help set a steady pace for boarding. This approach supports a quieter, safer transfer for pets and helps travelers feel confident during the process. If you are preparing to travel with a companion animal, a brief check of the crate, the label, and the papers before you reach the desk can save time and stress.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help with any label or crate concern.
